stories.title: Specsavers given green light to expand Mold High Street store
stories.summary: Specsavers has been given permission to expand its Mold High Street store into the shop next door. Flintshire County Council approved plans on 30 October to join 7 High Street with the neighbouring unit at 3-5 High Street, creating one larger store. stories.title: Flintshire council can’t say if recycling centre cuts saved £250,000
stories.summary: Flintshire Council cannot say whether cutting recycling centre opening hours saved the £250,000 it was supposed to, according to an internal audit. The audit gives the council’s management of household recycling centres and fly-tipping the lowest rating of “limited assurance”. It will go before the council’s environment and economy scrutiny committee on Tuesday (10 November).
